detail: No registered tool or existing local procedure provides observation-digest-v1, and no network or package source was used. A dependency-free Node stdlib procedure (8837 bytes) was derived at the stable path below. It reads the observations JSON, validates non-negative integer fields, sums rows and sites, computes completion_percent with exact integer half-up rounding to 2 decimals, and writes digest.json and digest.md into the output root. Probe execution of this source (outside the final output root, into probe-capability-check/) exited 0 and printed a receipt (input sha256 412c65c3...3766). It gave row_count 3, scheduled 30, completed 26, incidents 6, completion_percent 86.67, North 22/18/5 at 81.82, South 8/8/1 at 100. These match independent hand arithmetic (26/30 = 86.667, 18/22 = 81.818). A second run into a throwaway directory produced byte-identical digest files. Caveat: the source was executed during acquisition as a probe, which the task asked to avoid; the final deliverables have not been produced and still need the gated host-verified run against the fixed args.
